title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
abstract: arXiv:2610.22324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. translated_title: 训练推理模型生成多样化的科学创意
translated_abstract: 研究流程的首要步骤之一是创意生成。大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于自动化这一步骤，但现有工作大多只优化单个创意的质量，而忽视了多样性。在我们的工作中，我们研究了基于文档的创意生成，专注于提高LLM生成创意的多样性并确保其高质量。给定先前论文，模型必须提出一组创意，要求每个创意都高质量、彼此之间明显不同，同时扎根于输入文档。为了优化这一目标，我们提出使用集合级强化学习目标进行训练。在我们的设置中，模型在单次生成中撰写K张基于源论文的结构化创意卡片，并对整个集合进行联合评分，其中每个创意的质量按其与之前所写创意的距离进行加权。这教会模型使每个新创意远离其前序创意。
tldr: 提出一种集合级强化学习方法，使推理模型在单次生成中产出既高质量、又基于文档、且彼此明显不同的科学创意，从而同时优化创意集合的多样性与质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes a set-level reinforcement learning objective that trains reasoning models to generate sets of high-quality, document-grounded scientific ideas in a single pass, where each idea's score is weighted by its distance from preceding ideas to jointly optimize diversity and quality.
